THE ORDERING IS PROVABLE FROM COMMIT TIMES RATHER THAN ASSERTED, AND IT IS THE CLAIM vc CAN MAKE THAT snorkeltoast CANNOT FROM THEIR OWN TREE. Every entry's disposition was decided in this contract BEFORE the code that implements it: ease >= dwell refused -- AC-3.11 minted 3438fd1 11:05, design 864a7f8 10:31, limits.rs first appears 930b31c 12:55, so the contract leads by 1h50m; max_ease clamped at 2400 -- same design commit 10:31 against the same 12:55, leading by 2h24m; a missing declared favicon refused and a .ttf refused by name -- design 151c5a7 17:47, NOT IMPLEMENTED; a missing font file refused -- design bbca403 18:01, NOT IMPLEMENTED. For the last three the ordering is not merely provable but unarguable, because the behaviour does not exist yet.

THE MECHANISM IS WIRED INTO THE INSTRUMENT THAT WOULD OTHERWISE DISCOVER THE DIFFERENCE, NOT ONLY INTO A NEW VERB. `cmd_compare` reads the expectations and prints them BEFORE the structure check, and the code says why the position is the mechanism: "move this block below the structure check and it still prints the same words, and they stop being evidence of anything." A predicted structural difference prints as PREDICTED and names the entry that predicted it; an unpredicted one still reaches `die("STRUCTURAL MISMATCH -- N unpredicted difference(s)")`, whose remedy names the constraint -- add it to PORT_EXPECTATIONS "but only if it was decided before it was observed". The match is an EXACT STRING and the looser rule is refused with its reason: anything mentioning ease on a named slide would swallow a real ease regression on that slide, "an unexplained-but-actually-fine difference costs a human one look; the other direction costs a silent pass".

THE TABLE PREDICATES ON INPUTS, NOT ON cc'S ERROR TEXT, so it does not stop matching the day somebody rewords a message -- and two of the five behaviours have no string to match because they are not written yet.

RUN AGAINST THE LIVE 45h REEL, 2026-09-09: 1 of 5 predictions fires, and it is the BLIND one, shipped-max-ease. THAT IS THE GOOD OUTCOME AND THE LINE SAYS WHICH KIND OF ZERO IT IS -- report_expectations distinguishes "none of the 5 predictions apply to this reel's inputs" from a claim about the table, because "the two read identically unless the line says which". The four silent entries are detectors over CONFIGS and not over this reel; 45h authors no ease at or above its dwell, none above 2400, popupart ships favicon.svg, and all five fonts are .woff2.

THE DETECTOR IS RED-PROVED WHERE IT CAN BE AND HONESTLY MARKED WHERE IT CANNOT. Two entries are `observed` with the observation quoted: dwell 3s / ease 4s drove cc's binary to exit 2 naming the segment, and authored ease 5s drove exit 0 with "timing 1 segment(s) clamped by the envelope" against Python's 5000. Two are `designed`, carry `evidence: None`, and carry `unobserved` saying why nothing could be observed -- the port's `check` verb does not read the theme at all, `theme` being `pub mod` in lib.rs with no call site in main.rs. One is BLIND by construction. A selftest arm refuses the table if a row claims `observed` and cites nothing, or is `designed` and cites evidence, or is `designed` and does not say why -- AND THAT CHECK WAS ITSELF RED-PROVED BY INJECTION AFTER ITS FIRST VERSION WAS NOT: flipping a designed row to observed left it green, because both rows carried prose in `evidence` explaining that nothing had been observed, so the field meant "a paragraph" and the check tested that a paragraph was present.

WHAT THIS ROW DOES NOT CLAIM. It does not claim the port refuses a missing favicon or a .ttf today -- it does not; those two entries are DESIGNED and will flip to `observed` when cc's code lands, which is the state the field exists to record. This row is discharged on the harness's mechanism and on the ordering, both of which are complete.

ONE GAP, RAISED WITH snorkeltoast RATHER THAN HELD AGAINST THE ROW: the two `observed` entries cite `crates/showreel/src/limits.rs` as their `source` and not the contract disposition that predates it, so the table's own claim that the prediction existed FIRST is checkable from git but not from the table.
